given: a stock record whose serial_number holds a value
when: an API client fetches that stock record
then: the response contains a distinct serial_number field carrying that record's serial value

independence.rationale: AC1 covers exposing batch_number; this AC covers serial_number. A serializer that maps batch but not serial makes AC1 green while this fails, and vice versa, so the two field exposures are independently breakable.

architectural_notes: API/boundary AC on the same JSON stock endpoint (app/routes/) as AC1, distinct because it maps a second, independently-omittable model field. serial_number flows from app/models/ through app/repositories/ and app/services/ to the boundary serializer, which emits it as its own key alongside batch_number. Owner module: the stock response serializer at the boundary; no domain logic. Cross-cutting concern: response contract completeness, owned by the API layer; verified by an R4 real-branch test seeding a serial-bearing row.
